title: SonicWall: retire Gen 6 firewalls now, no more patches even for critical flaws
summary: SonicWall's advisory of 18 November says every Gen 6 and Gen 6.5 firewall running SonicOS 6.x, including NSv, has reached end of support and will get no firmware or security patches regardless of severity. SonicWall says it expects internet-facing Gen 6 units to be actively targeted and tells customers to replace them with Gen 8. No new CVE is named.
plain: SonicWall says its older Gen 6 firewalls will never get security fixes again and should be replaced, especially if they face the internet.
exec: Unpatchable internet-edge firewalls become a permanent entry point; replacement needs budget and lead time.
action: Inventory every Gen 6 unit; replace internet-facing ones first; meanwhile disable WAN management and SSL VPN (or restrict sources), enforce MFA, and monitor logs.

validation.note: Vendor advisory (primary) read in full, plus Help Net Security. Exploitation of Gen 6 is expected by SonicWall, not reported; severity 3 reflects the vendor's urgent replace-now notice for internet-facing devices.

review.note: Compared title, 18 Nov date, Gen 6/6.5 SonicOS 6.x scope, no patches regardless of severity, expected targeting, Gen 8 replacement, no new CVE against SonicWall advisory and Help Net Security
